olivia_csm: Quick alert — onboarding is failing for a small group of VPC trial tenants during token refresh (noticed ~09:05 UTC). Drafting customer messaging and remediation offers; need ops/finance signoff. Incident INC-2025-900. @jamal_support any confirmed failure mode?
jamal_support: Reproduced. Refresh handler returns 401 when refresh_window is negative due to a recent change that treats 0/neg as invalid. Log: `auth.refresh tenant=tn-A12 status=401 window=-1`. Steps: create tenant -> onboarding job -> refresh -> 401.
steve_eng: Root cause: an extra validation introduced in PR #4123. Hotfix plan: revert validation, add boundary tests, and deploy a targeted rollback. Canary in eu-central-1 at 09:30 UTC, full rollout ~10:00 UTC.
incident-bot: INC-2025-900 | created | sev: high | impacted: ~31 trial VPC tenants | status: investigating
liam_csm: Of those, 7 expire within two weeks; 3 are flagged enterprise prospects. We should offer deeper remediation for the 3 (migration assistance + prioritized onboarding).
olivia_csm: Draft customer note for trials (short): 'Hi — we're aware some new VPC tenants are blocked during onboarding. Engineers are deploying a fix and we expect onboarding to be restored within ~60 minutes. Affected trials will receive a 7-day trial extension and access to a priority onboarding session. Reply here to schedule.'
jamal_support: Add immediate workaround to the message: customers can rotate the onboarding token from Console or trigger a manual retry of the onboarding job. Support reply template: 'If you'd like us to retry on your behalf, reply with tenant_id and we'll prioritize.' Example retry curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/onboard/retry -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"tenant_id":"tn-A12"}'`
sam_ops: I can flip a soft-auth-relax flag per-tenant while rollback proceeds. Will enable for the impacted cohort now and monitor auth-success rate. Paste the 3 enterprise tenant IDs here and I'll escalate them to priority.
mona_finance: Finance check: 7-day trial extensions and one priority workshop per impacted tenant are approved under goodwill policy GWP-2. Tag credits with INC-2025-900 for ledger.
olivia_csm: Thanks — I'll prepare two outreach variants: 1) short trial blast (above) and 2) enterprise outreach offering migration assistance, engineer shadowing during setup, and a follow-up RCA + survey. Final ask: ops and eng confirm flag is enabled and canary health; then I'll send messages.
steve_eng: Canary started; initial health looks good. I'll confirm in 10m and publish a brief one-line RCA in follow-up: 'Cause: a validation regression rejected valid refresh windows.' We'll link the postmortem later.
jamal_support: After rollback, we'll provide a support macro for responses and an internal triage label to track any customers who need manual retries or provisioning.
olivia_csm: Perfect. I'll queue the trial blast once Sam confirms the flag and Steve confirms rollout. I'll DM the 3 enterprise IDs for priority handling and start scheduling onboarding sessions for respondents. Thanks everyone.
